blocks.text: Exercise 19.1. The following is a function that computes the binomial coefficient recursively.

blocks.code:
def binomial_coeff(n, k):
    """Compute the binomial coefficient "n choose k".

    n: number of trials
    k: number of successes

    returns: int
    """
    if k == 0:
        return 1
    if n == 0:
        return 0

    res = binomial_coeff(n-1, k) + binomial_coeff(n-1, k-1)
    return res
blocks.description: Recursive computation of the binomial coefficient using Pascal's rule.

blocks.text:
Rewrite the body of the function using nested conditional expressions.

One note: this function is not very efficient because it ends up computing the same values over and over. You could make it more efficient by memoizing (see Section 11.6). But you will find that it's harder to memoize if you write it using conditional expressions.
